note: Ticket 472: the Upgrades results rows adopt the Gear item list's row idioms (3rem icon, 1.125rem quality-coloured name, zebra, hover) and gain two trailing action cells (favorite star, add-to-Batch-Sim). The post-run entry's facts are the Gear-side facts of manifest-gear.json measured on the Upgrades table, so the two facts.json files can be compared pair by pair at 1280. The harness captures a RUNNING state at >=5 landed rows (MIN_ROWS), driven at RUN_WIDTH 653 and then re-emulated per width, so the post-run capture proves the row look and the two action cells on real rows, not a completed run. Round 2 (after the gate-visual cannot-judge on the 375 clause): the 375 case is split into its own entry 472-narrow with no hover interaction, capturing the .upgrades-results scroll host as well as the table, and measuring the overflow arithmetically (tableRect vs scrollHostRect vs overflow-x) rather than asking a clipped PNG to show it. The harness computes an interaction's coordinate before the width is re-emulated, so a hover at 375 lands on the wrong row; the hover pair stays on the 1280 entry, where it is measured correctly.

entries.acceptance: Pre-run the tab is unchanged: no results table and no empty action headings on screen.
At 1280 an Upgrades row reads as a Gear-list row - same icon size, name size, zebra and hover colours (facts equal the 472-gear entry's) - with a star and a batch button as the last two cells.

At 375 the row is the pre-change mobile row plus the two buttons: the 1.125rem icon and 14px name are unchanged, zebra rows 1 and 2 differ, both buttons are present as the last two cells, and the table is wider than its host (tableRect.width > scrollHostRect.width with overflow-x auto) so it scrolls horizontally rather than shattering. Hover is not measured at this width: the harness computes the pointer coordinate before re-emulating the width, so a hover interaction lands on the wrong row -- 1280 carries the hover evidence.
